PianoPlayer 3.0.2 — https://github.com/marcomusy/pianoplayer

Unmodified `hand.py`, `models.py`, and `__init__.py` from the PyPI 3.0.2
wheel, with upstream MIT LICENSE. Only its CPU optimizer is used; no
audio, visual, or MusicXML dependencies are required. Our adapter lives
in scripts/piano-fingering.py. Upstream copyright and license are retained.
